narr: Thunderstorms brought locally heavy rain to Middlesex County on the night of January 1. Rainfall amounts of 1.0 to 1.5 inches fell in a short amount of time.
ev: Flash flooding occurred in New Brunswick. College Avenue was closed near NJ Route 18. Joyce Kilmer Avenue was closed near Charles Street. Jersey Avenue was under water near Tailer Square.
